summary: Emit uritime urtlog records for fixos diagnostics and cleanup vetos

delivery.outcome: Add fail-open uritime.urtlog.record/v2 emitter in fixos/diagnostics/urtlog_emit.py and emit veto telemetry from evaluate_cleanup_vetos.
nonGoals: Touching fixos/cli/fix_cmd.py or any file reserved by foreign leases.

architecture.decision: Introduce fixos/diagnostics/urtlog_emit.py with fail-open JSONL emission controlled by FIXOS_URTLOG_STATE_DIR / URTLOG_STATE_DIR and invoke emit_cleanup_veto when evaluate_cleanup_vetos returns HOLD_PROTECTED.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit adding fixos/diagnostics/urtlog_emit.py and its call in fixos/diagnostics/project_scanner.py.

validation.evidence: Unit tests verify uritime.urtlog.record/v2 emission, no-op when unconfigured, fail-open on OSError, and veto event emission from evaluate_cleanup_vetos.
